dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse distribution of small, solid light-intensity pixel clusters appearing as localized flecks, most visible along the upper dorsal curve and the lower posterior flank, lacking internal tonal gradients.
